concurrency_model.per_session_stdio: Each Claude/Codex/Gemini session spawns its OWN child process per stdio server -> correctness-isolated (no shared state) but N sessions = N× processes = N× RAM. This is the RAM-OOM tax (MEMORY: ram_oom_mcp_diagnosis, semgrep ~920MB/session). Mitigation = fewer always-on stdio servers + hubs + flip-on.
concurrency_model.shared_daemon: http/sse local (basic-memory:8765, agent-mail:8812, angr:8760): ONE process serves N sessions -> RAM-efficient but a shared-state singleton (basic-memory SQLite -> write-contention/wedge risk; deployment must not hard-depend on it).
concurrency_model.remote: http remote (deepwiki/figma/huggingface/github/notion/linear/apify): concurrency handled provider-side; cost = tool-schema context only.
concurrency_model.external_backend: RE servers (ida/ghidra/frida/binja/cheatengine/hexstrike): per-session MCP child + ONE shared external backend GUI/server -> multi-session contends on the single backend; keep flip-on.
